note: Production run 8: the large caravel made from the picked caravel pictures, so her colours match.

items.prompt: Edit this photograph and keep her exactly as she is in colour, materials and light: the same warm golden sails, the same dark tarred wood and weathering, the same rigging, the same flat chroma-green background and the same side-on view, bow to the right. Make her a larger caravel (caravela latina grande): a longer hull, about a quarter longer, and a THIRD mast with its own triangular lateen sail on a long slanted yard, so she has three lateen sails in all, the tallest forward. Nothing else changes: no square sails, no gunports, no portholes. The whole ship from the mastheads to the keel in frame, with a margin all round, on flat green.
